run_binaural_training: run the binaural speech synthesis training pipeline with configurable GPU count and dataset path
create_binaural_dataset: create a BinauralDataset from a directory of audio files with 200ms chunks and 50% overlap
build_binaural_network: build a BinauralNetwork with configurable wavenet blocks, layers per block, and channel dimensions
train_binaural_model: train a binaural speech synthesis model using the Trainer with configurable learning rate and epochs
review_training_config: review the training configuration including loss weights, batch size, and NEWBOb decay parameters
